svg.title: Each README covers its own folder, and the root holds only the imported summaries
svg.desc: The root README covers compose.yaml. Below it, services/api/README.md covers services/api/, services/web/README.md covers services/web/, and libs/shared/README.md covers libs/shared/. The api and web READMEs each export a summary, and the root imports both summaries. The root links libs/shared/README.md, which hands that folder over but carries no summary.
